References to helpful resources for canc.Explanation: The ACS Survivorship Center provides comprehensive resources for cancer survivors, which can help the patient manage their health and well-being during follow-up care. This is particularly relevant given the patient's ongoing symptoms and need for support post-treatment.

Journey Forward offers tools and resources to help cancer survivors manage their care and health post-treatment. This can be beneficial for the patient to track their symptoms and follow-up care needs.
The ASCO site provides valuable information and resources for cancer survivors and their caregivers, which can help the patient understand their condition and manage their symptoms effectively.
NCCN provides guidelines and resources for patients and caregivers, which can help the patient navigate their post-treatment care and manage any ongoing symptoms or side effects.
Patient navigation services can help guide the patient through the cancer care continuum, ensuring they receive appropriate follow-up care and support for managing their symptoms and side effects.
Peer support groups can provide emotional support and empowerment to the patient, helping them cope with the psychological impact of their cancer diagnosis and treatment.

The CA Patient Page offers information on surveillance, screening, symptom management, healthy behaviors, and care coordination, which can be useful for the patient in managing their health post-treatment.
